Required: central adventure scenery remains visible during combat with visible horizon; enemy cards upper area only during combat; exactly EIGHT friendly upright rectangular cards remain fully readable in bottom area throughout exploration and battle. Dark jade, antique pale gold fine frame pieces, paper/grain textures, restrained red health circles, small cooldown arcs. All card art is 2D cutout illustration. Chinese labels short and legible. No giant opaque enemy panel, no oversized circular skills, no fan of overlapping unreadable cards, no huge effects, no modern sci-fi. Show one restrained projectile with clear direction toward enemy. This is a proposed design reference, NOT a finished UI texture asset. Use modular small ornaments and stretchable simple backing design suitable for later implementation.
